decisions.reason: As an outpatient sociotherapy service it is very close to our core mental health and support expertise, and its move from a website mention in 2023 to the home page in 2024 suggests we are learning from and strengthening it rather than preparing to exit.
Counseling for senior living fits directly with our established eldercare capabilities, and its home-page visibility in both 2023 and 2024 indicates a well-integrated offer with low withdrawal risk.

The retail shop extends our sheltered workshop activities and therefore builds on related knowledge we already possess, while its stronger placement on the home page in 2024 points to growing strategic relevance despite being somewhat more peripheral than core care services.

Meal delivery for seniors is still new and only lightly evidenced on the website, but it is close to our senior-support business and, given our own R&D and expansion, we would usually retain it long enough to refine and integrate it.
